description: A dynamic block for an unrequested block type is an error even when it generates no blocks
notes: The README says the generated blocks are read as if they were written in place of the dynamic block, and an empty collection generates none, so no unexpected block is left. hashicorp/hcl reports a dynamic block for a block type the schema doesn't request before it evaluates for_each (expandBody.expandBlocks in ext/dynblock/expand_body.go).
reference_error: Blocks of type "c" are not expected here
